issue_context.title: Cleanup dead code in the codebase
issue_context.body:
https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/pull/111654 started here but it got big (shocking!) and the contributor got busy.  There are a lot of potential cleanups in there, though, and I hate wasting work.

I see it as an opportunity for someone to rack up some PRs and net-negative LOCs (the best kind!) - just take over that PR, break it up into a bunch of smaller PRs, and send them our way!

A very eager beaver might automate this, but there's a lot of manually-identified low-hanging fruit, I think.

I would like to point out that [CRI-Dockerd](https://github.com/Mirantis/cri-dockerd/blob/master/network/hostport/hostport_manager.go#L70) was in fact using some of the "unused" functions in https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/pull/115103. Just because K8s is not using the function doesn't mean some other repo/project is not.
@dereknola we don't have guarantees about functions/methods etc. CRI-dockerd is welcome to copy the ones that dropped off from there.
To be crystal clear - we do not support or endorse importing `k8s.io/kubernetes/...` AT ALL.  We offer no guarantees of stability there.

review_comments:
These functions represent a sort of API to the api packages.  It sure seems like this is not used, but I don't know why it was there.

@lavalamp or @deads2k or @jpbetz - can we get a consult?
I would not remove these unless you can show that no one uses the corresponding function from any api package.
As discussed in comments - we should leave these ones.  They represent a package-api.
